name: mr-video
description: Render a subtitled explainer video of a GitLab MR change and embed it at the top of the MR description.

interface.shortDescription: Explain an MR with a subtitled video
interface.longDescription: Render a subtitle-only explainer video of the author's GitLab MR change (diagrams, before/after code, comparison tables), upload it, and embed it at the top of the MR description without touching the rest of the text. Windows only.
defaultPrompt: Use $mr-video to render a subtitled explainer video of this GitLab MR and embed it in the MR description.
